style: Playful and clear, an inviting friend exploring sounds. Isolated stops crisp with no added vowel; sustained sounds about 0.8 seconds.
lines: Tap any lantern. Or choose a letter below.
Tap the lantern to hear it. Or try Trace.
Tap either flame to hear its vowel sound.
Start at the green dot and follow the arrow. Or tap Back to lantern.
Trace the small letter. Or tap Back to lantern.
Draw on the slate. Tap Next stroke, or Back to lantern, whenever you like.
The whole letter is shown over your ink. Draw again, or tap Back to lantern.
Watch this stroke. You can draw whenever you like.
Follow the arrow to the end.
Tap lanterns to hear sounds. Tap the window to reveal the word.
Tap lanterns to compare sounds. Tap a window to reveal its word.
Tap either word board to hear the word and its vowel.
Tap a banner to hear the whole word.
Tap a shop, a banner, or Read the street.
Tap a lantern, shop, banner, or Read the street.
The street is asleep. Tap Lanterns and choose any letter, or tap a shop to explore its sign.
This shop is ready to explore. Tap its window to hear the word.
Tap letters and banners to hide or show them. Tap Close to return.
All letters are hidden. Tap Settings to show some.
Tap Settings to show more letters, or tap Lanterns.
Your village is saved on this device only. Nothing leaves it.
Choose a lantern, trace a letter, or open the Wordbook. You can explore in any order.
Isolated sounds use recordings. Without a recording, you hear an anchor word instead of a letter name.
Clear this village? Tap Clear village or Cancel.
Tap another shop or banner, or explore the next street.
